senses.gloss:
m. (-धः)
Ignorance, stupidity.
mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
1 Ignorant, stupid.
2 Puzzled, perplexed.
E.
अ neg. बोध knowledge.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Incomprehensible.
E.
अ neg. बोध knowledge, गम्य to be attained by.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Unintelligible.
2 Not to be awakened or aroused.
E.
अ neg. बोधनीय to be understood, &c. also अबोधितव्य and अबोध्य.

n. (-नं)
1 Knowledge, understanding.
2 Instructing, informing.
E.
आङ्, बुध to know, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
